measurement_rules: Lossless and progressive figures have different delivery coverage and are not interchangeable.
Only render-3 artifacts supply final figures; earlier render folders are retained, not overwritten.
Character counts are not token counts, model accuracy, or measured human usability.
Capture helpers are bound to recorded query contracts and package hashes. Later view/default changes require a new explicit experiment; do not silently rerun and claim historical equivalence.
Saved data can be rendered offline without constructing a ledger or accessing original transcript pools.
